Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import json
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from openai import OpenAI


STANDARD_EXPENSE_SCHEMA = {
    "document_type": None,
    "vendor_name": None,
    "invoice_number": None,
    "receipt_number": None,
    "purchase_order_number": None,
    "transaction_date": None,
    "due_date": None,
    "currency": None,
    "subtotal": None,
    "tax": None,
    "tip": None,
    "shipping": None,
    "discount": None,
    "total": None,
    "payment_method": None,
    "card_last4": None,
    "merchant_address": {
        "street": None,
        "city": None,
        "state": None,
        "postal_code": None,
        "country": None,
    },
    "line_items": [],
    "notes": None,
}


def _schema_definition() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": False,
        "properties": {
            "document_type": {
                "type": ["string", "null"],
                "enum": ["receipt", "invoice", "credit_note", "other", None],
            },
            "vendor_name": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "invoice_number": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "receipt_number": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "purchase_order_number": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "transaction_date": {
                "type": ["string", "null"],
                "description": "ISO-8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD when available",
            },
            "due_date": {
                "type": ["string", "null"],
                "description": "ISO-8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD when available",
            },
            "currency": {
                "type": ["string", "null"],
                "description": "ISO 4217 currency code like USD, EUR",
            },
            "subtotal": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "tax": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "tip": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "shipping": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "discount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "total": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "payment_method": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "card_last4": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "merchant_address": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": False,
                "properties": {
                    "street": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    "city": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    "state": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    "postal_code": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    "country": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                },
                "required": ["street", "city", "state", "postal_code", "country"],
            },
            "line_items": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "additionalProperties": False,
                    "properties": {
                        "description": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                        "quantity": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
                        "unit_price": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
                        "amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
                        "category": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    },
                    "required": ["description", "quantity", "unit_price", "amount", "category"],
                },
            },
            "notes": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
        },
        "required": [
            "document_type",
            "vendor_name",
            "invoice_number",
            "receipt_number",
            "purchase_order_number",
            "transaction_date",
            "due_date",
            "currency",
            "subtotal",
            "tax",
            "tip",
            "shipping",
            "discount",
            "total",
            "payment_method",
            "card_last4",
            "merchant_address",
            "line_items",
            "notes",
        ],
    }


def _deep_merge_defaults(data: Any, defaults: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(defaults, dict):
        result = {}
        source = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
        for key, default_value in defaults.items():
            result[key] = _deep_merge_defaults(source.get(key), default_value)
        return result
    if isinstance(defaults, list):
        return data if isinstance(data, list) else []
    return data if data is not None else defaults


def normalize_expense_fields(
    extracted_fields: Dict[str, Any],
    model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini",
    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

    prompt = (
        "Normalize the provided extracted expense document fields into the required JSON schema.\n"
        "Rules:\n"
        "- Output only valid JSON matching the schema.\n"
        "- Preserve known values when possible.\n"
        "- Convert dates to YYYY-MM-DD when inferable.\n"
        "- Convert money fields to numbers without currency symbols.\n"
        "- Currency must be a 3-letter ISO code when inferable.\n"
        "- Use null for unknown scalar fields.\n"
        "- Use [] for unknown line_items.\n"
        "- Infer document_type as receipt, invoice, credit_note, or other.\n"
        "- Do not include fields outside the schema.\n"
    )

    response = client.responses.create(
        model=model,
        input=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a precise document normalization service for expense records.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": [
                    {"type": "input_text", "text": prompt},
                    {
                        "type": "input_text",
                        "text": json.dumps(extracted_fields, ensure_ascii=False),
                    },
                ],
            },
        ],
        text={
            "format": {
                "type": "json_schema",
                "name": "normalized_expense",
                "schema": _schema_definition(),
                "strict": True,
            }
        },
    )

    parsed = json.loads(response.output_text)
    return _deep_merge_defaults(parsed, STANDARD_EXPENSE_SCHEMA)
